provenance.selection: Proofread neurons; exclude unresolved tracing issues, unrooted, too-small and non-neurons. Eight annotated DNa01/DNa02/DNp01/DNp09 DNs; strongest 160 direct VNC interneuron targets at >=5 synapses; strongest 64 identified VNC motor targets reachable in one or two hops at >=5. Retain ALL induced edges for adjustable filtering. Omit all external input and all other neurons.
provenance.id_policy: Root IDs are strings throughout; array indices are local only.
provenance.attribution: BANC: Bates, Phelps, Kim, Yang et al., Nature (2026). Compiled tables: S. J. C. Barnes / BANC tutorial. See linked sources for data terms.
